data.gender_notes: Gauthier is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Germanic element 'gaut', meaning 'god' or 'good', and the Old French 'ier', meaning 'warrior'. The name Gauthier is of medieval French origin and translates to 'powerful warrior'. The name Gauthier carries the meaning “Powerful warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gauthier usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
